name: kibana-log-investigation
description: Install the local Kibana log investigation MCP from this repository.

interface.shortDescription: Local Kibana log investigation MCP for Codex
interface.longDescription: Use the repo-local read-only Kibana investigation MCP in Codex. Bootstrap a verified machine profile from an Elasticsearch index without importing the example catalog or editing client configuration.
defaultPrompt: Install the Kibana Log Investigation plugin from this repo, bootstrap Node.js if needed, and run the prompt-free profile bootstrap from my Elasticsearch index with --client none.
Use the Kibana Log Investigation plugin to inspect log sources and query a time window.
